title: AI Model Watch — 2026-10-22
lead: This edition covers 6 days and logs 1 release from the providers we track: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, which DeepSeek describes as a minor update to its previous Flash model, with open weights and API access. It was a quiet week, and we do not pad the log. The catalog also records access and sourcing corrections found by this week's fact-check. We summarise what providers say, link each source, and do not assess it. The benchmark ran no measurement of its own in this window.

scanned: Official announcement pages, model cards, API changelogs and deprecation pages from the eighteen providers in the catalog: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, Mistral AI, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Microsoft, Amazon, Cohere, IBM, Ai2, NVIDIA, Moonshot AI, Zhipu AI, TII and LG AI Research
Hugging Face organisation pages for open-weights releases
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's dated list of newly released models
notScanned: The OpenAI and xAI news pages refused our requests; we used their changelogs, deprecation pages and model documentation instead
Qwen, IBM and LG AI Research sites did not render for us; for those providers we checked Hugging Face listings and searches only, so an API-only release could have been missed
Providers outside the eighteen listed above, including regional and domain-specific model developers
Consumer-app feature changes that were not announced as a model release
Notices dated before this window that the previous edition did not log; they are being checked for a dated correction to that edition

releases.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, which DeepSeek describes as a minor update to V4.1-Flash, went live on the DeepSeek API, app and website, with MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
